{{Quote|If you're interested, fifty-one of the seventy crates I've clocked on this watch show up on the CSF database tagged as criminal.|RC-1207 "Sev"|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force database''', also referred to as the '''Galactic City Police central database''' or '''police grid''', was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] storage system with [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] of information maintained by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].

==Description==
The database included information on CSF patrols and shift schedules, information gathered on current incidents from the [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|CSF central control room]], information on traffic routes, crime statistics, criminal cases and on-going investigations, evidence, weapons, vehicles, criminals, merchandise, and shipping and transport crates as well as other information.

The database could be accessed by police officers on most [[Computer/Legends|computer consoles]] including on [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and in their [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|police speeders]]. Other [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] including the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] could also access the database for information on both planetary and galactic criminals, on-going cases, and other information. [[JN-66 analysis droid/Legends|JN-66 analysis droids]] and [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4 analysis droids]] from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives's]] [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|analysis wing]] were linked to the CSF database to share information on criminal cases with the Jedi Archives database.
